actions.action: Slide the plant out of the pot and check the roots
If the roots are black or mushy, trim them and repot in fresh well-draining soil
Fill the self-watering bulb and refill it whenever it is empty
Alternatively, remove the bulb and water by hand
Check the soil and water thoroughly when the top 1-2 inches are dry
Move the plant to bright, indirect light near an east or north window
Trim dead and crispy stems back to healthy growth
Pinch stem tips to encourage bushier growth
Consider moving it to a hanging basket or upright setup

reason: The answer correctly identifies low light but blames underwatering instead of overwatering. Its advice to move the plant to brighter light matches part of the fix, but it omits laying the vines on the soil to root. Telling the owner to water well now and keep the bulb filled would likely worsen an overwatered plant.
